runtime-error-attribute-description.defaultMessage: The object does not provide the requested property or method. The name, object or library version may be different from the example.

runtime-error-check-attribute-spelling.defaultMessage: Check the property or method name and which object is stored in the variable before the dot.

runtime-error-check-bus-reuse.defaultMessage: Reuse the existing bus or pin object. Put initialisation before the main loop so it runs only once.

runtime-error-check-division-zero.defaultMessage: Check the denominator before dividing and handle the case where it is zero.

runtime-error-check-file-backup.defaultMessage: Save a copy of your files before changing storage settings, and use the board documentation for that configuration.

runtime-error-check-file-path.defaultMessage: Check the filename, uppercase/lowercase letters and path on CIRCUITPY.

runtime-error-check-file-transfer.defaultMessage: Make sure required data files were transferred too and that the program reads from the expected directory.

runtime-error-check-indent-level.defaultMessage: Align instructions in the same block and indent the body after a colon.

runtime-error-check-indent-spaces.defaultMessage: Use spaces consistently, usually four per level, and avoid mixing tabs with spaces.

runtime-error-check-index-length.defaultMessage: Compare the index with len(sequence). In a non-empty sequence, the first position is 0 and the last is len(sequence) - 1.

runtime-error-check-index-loop.defaultMessage: Check the limits of your loop and whether the sequence can be empty or shorter than expected.

runtime-error-check-io-connection.defaultMessage: Use the traceback to check whether the failing operation accesses a sensor, another device or a file. Check that connection first.

runtime-error-check-io-files.defaultMessage: For file access, check the path, available space and whether the computer is still writing files. For a sensor, check its connection and power.

runtime-error-check-key-exists.defaultMessage: Check whether the key exists before accessing it, or use get() with a suitable default.

runtime-error-check-key-spelling.defaultMessage: Compare the key’s exact spelling and type with the keys in the dictionary.

runtime-error-check-memory-data.defaultMessage: Reduce large lists, images or buffers, and load only the data needed for the next step.

runtime-error-check-memory-loop.defaultMessage: Check whether a loop keeps collecting data or creating new objects without releasing old ones.

runtime-error-check-module-name.defaultMessage: Check the module name in the import statement and the spelling of any imported name.

runtime-error-check-module-transfer.defaultMessage: Transfer the project again. Known libraries for static imports are installed automatically; other libraries may need manual installation in CIRCUITPY/lib.

runtime-error-check-module-version.defaultMessage: Use a CircuitPython-compatible library version. The editor’s automatic compiled libraries target CircuitPython 10.x.

runtime-error-check-name-initialize.defaultMessage: Assign the variable before using it. For a sensor, insert its initialisation block first and keep the same object name.

runtime-error-check-name-spelling.defaultMessage: Compare the spelling, including uppercase and lowercase letters, at the definition and at the error location.

runtime-error-check-pin-setup.defaultMessage: Find repeated initialisation of the same pin or I²C connection.

runtime-error-check-power-address.defaultMessage: Check that the sensor is powered and that the configured I²C address matches the sensor.

runtime-error-check-readonly-mode.defaultMessage: Check whether the file should be written by the computer or by the board. CircuitPython’s storage configuration controls write access.

runtime-error-check-sensor-driver.defaultMessage: Check that the sensor model, driver and property names match the example and the installed library version.

runtime-error-check-syntax-previous.defaultMessage: Also inspect the previous line: the missing character may be above the reported location.

runtime-error-check-syntax-punctuation.defaultMessage: Check colons, matching brackets and quotation marks.

runtime-error-check-type-arguments.defaultMessage: Compare the number, order and types of arguments with the function example.

runtime-error-check-type-conversion.defaultMessage: Inspect the actual values, for example with print(type(value)). Convert text and numbers only when the operation requires it.

runtime-error-check-unknown-isolate.defaultMessage: Review your latest changes and try a smaller example to find which operation triggers the error.

runtime-error-check-unknown-location.defaultMessage: Inspect the last matching project line in the traceback and the final error message.

runtime-error-check-value-input.defaultMessage: Print the input values immediately before the calculation or call, and check how they were obtained.

runtime-error-check-value-range.defaultMessage: Check the allowed values, units and limits of the affected argument.

runtime-error-check-wiring.defaultMessage: Check the cable and the SDA/SCL connections against the sensor example.

runtime-error-division-description.defaultMessage: A calculation attempted to divide by zero.

runtime-error-file-description.defaultMessage: A requested file or directory could not be found on the board.

runtime-error-i2c-description.defaultMessage: The message indicates a problem reaching an I²C device or detecting the I²C lines. It does not by itself identify the exact cause.

runtime-error-import-description.defaultMessage: Python could not import a requested module or name. Its spelling, installation or version may not match the code.

runtime-error-indentation-description.defaultMessage: Python cannot interpret the indentation. Indentation determines which instructions belong to a loop, condition or function.

runtime-error-index-description.defaultMessage: The program tried to access a position that does not exist in a sequence, such as a list or text.

runtime-error-io-description.defaultMessage: An input/output operation failed. This can involve hardware communication or a file; this message alone does not prove a sensor fault.

runtime-error-key-description.defaultMessage: The requested key does not exist in this dictionary.

runtime-error-memory-description.defaultMessage: The board does not have enough available working memory for this operation.

runtime-error-name-description.defaultMessage: A name has no value at this point in the program. It may be misspelled, not yet initialised or only defined in another scope.

runtime-error-no-project-location.defaultMessage: This traceback has no matching file in your project. Use the original traceback below to identify the library or code involved.

runtime-error-pins-description.defaultMessage: A pin is already being used. The program may be trying to initialise the same connection more than once.

runtime-error-readonly-description.defaultMessage: The program tried to write to a filesystem that is currently read-only.

runtime-error-stale.defaultMessage: The project has changed or has not been transferred since connecting. Line numbers may refer to different code. Transfer the current project and check the new error before opening a location.

runtime-error-syntax-description.defaultMessage: Python cannot read the structure of this code. A punctuation mark or part of an instruction may be missing.

runtime-error-type-description.defaultMessage: An operation received a value of the wrong type, or a function was called with unsuitable arguments.

runtime-error-unknown-description.defaultMessage: There is no specific explanation for this message yet. The original traceback remains the starting point for finding the cause.

runtime-error-value-description.defaultMessage: A value has an unsuitable content or lies outside the accepted range. The original message may name the affected argument.
